prompt:
Hyper-realistic documentary photograph, shot on 35mm Fujicolor Superia 400 pushed one stop — fine natural grain, a green bias off the fluorescent light, muted and cool. Naturalistic motivated lighting only, no lens flares, calm observational tone.

Scene: the man from the reference images, on the same 2008 trading floor, has just flung a double handful of torn trade tickets into the air above his head; the paper scraps are still falling around him like confetti. He is laughing with his head tipped back, his tie pulled loose. Beside him a colleague in shirtsleeves slaps the desk with an open palm, and behind them rows of traders are on their phones, still working.

Camera: eye level, a few metres away across two desks, a monitor's dark edge in the near foreground on the left.

Lighting: overhead fluorescent tubes, flat and greenish.

Details: real skin texture, fine natural grain, ordinary and unstyled. Keep every screen and paper free of readable lettering.

Compose for a 16:9 frame.

Thanks.
